name: Wood Pusher
bio: Moves any piece anywhere it may legally go. Every game is a surprise, even to him.

name: Toby Jenkins
bio: Just learned how the pieces move and refuses to trade anything without asking twice.

name: Camila Morales
bio: Brings her Queen out on move two every single game hoping for a quick Scholar's Mate.

name: Gordon Whitaker
bio: Retired postman enjoying slow Sunday afternoon games while still learning piece values.

name: Kofi Mensah
bio: Plays brilliant opening moves he saw on TikTok before immediately blundering his rook.

name: Anja Lindqvist
bio: Pushes every pawn one square at a time to build a cozy wall around her King.

name: Tariq Al-Mansoor
bio: Swaps pieces the moment they meet in the centre, because fewer pieces means fewer things to worry about.

name: Mei-Ling Zhou
bio: Plays casually on her lunch break and tries to remember basic center control principles.

name: Mateo Silva
bio: Hyper-focused when ahead in material, but completely loses concentration after one mistake.

name: Brenda Galloway
bio: Prefers keeping all her pieces safely on the back two ranks for as long as possible.

name: Declan Byrne
bio: Never met a pawn sacrifice he didn't like, even when there is zero follow-up attack.

name: Kavita Sharma
bio: University student practicing basic checkmate patterns and trying to avoid one-move blunders.

name: Henrik Solberg
bio: Counts the pieces after every capture and trades whenever the numbers still look even.

name: Bernard Moreau
bio: Hates open boards and trades off Queens at the earliest opportunity to simplify things.

name: Zuri Ndiaye
bio: Launches immediate kingside pawn storms before even developing her bishops.

name: Ronan Gallagher
bio: Plays solid, straightforward Italian Game setups and relies on basic tactical awareness.

name: Nadia Koury
bio: Dangerous in chaotic middlegames, yet struggles to convert simple King-and-pawn endgames.

name: Mireille Laurent
bio: Patient club veteran who waits quietly for opponents to overextend and make mistakes.

name: Devon Brooks
bio: Always castles queenside so he can throw every single kingside pawn straight at your King.

name: Kenji Takahashi
bio: Follows classic opening checklists religiously: control the center, develop, and castle early.

name: Sofia Novak
bio: Trades down quickly once a pawn ahead, though not always into the right endgame.

name: Dennis Hoffman
bio: High school chemistry teacher who treats chess like a slow, methodical lab experiment.

name: Valeria Ortiz
bio: Specializes in tricky Fried Liver attacks and loves putting immediate pressure on f7.

name: Callum Fraser
bio: Junior club regular who simplifies sensibly and rarely hangs pieces for free.

name: Emeka Okafor
bio: Pulls off dazzling knight sacrifices on good days, but falls for simple back-rank mates.

name: Ingrid Halvorsen
bio: Loves closed positions and will happily shuffle her rooks for twenty moves without blinking.

name: Javier Mendoza
bio: Plays the King's Gambit exclusively and treats every game like an all-out sword fight.

name: Claire Pelletier
bio: Steady online rapid player focused on clean piece coordination and solid pawn structures.

name: Arjun Nair
bio: Happily trades off attackers to reach quiet endgames where he feels at home.

name: Alistair MacLeod
bio: Bookshop owner who prefers grinding out tiny structural advantages over flashy combinations.

name: Talia Ben-Ami
bio: Hunts down opposing Kings relentlessly, often sacrificing bishops to tear open pawn shields.

name: Lucas Kowalski
bio: Well-rounded high school captain equally comfortable in tactical scraps and quiet endgames.

name: Yasmine Haddad
bio: Plays bizarre, offbeat openings that confuse opponents before suddenly finding sharp tactics.

name: Martin Lindholm
bio: Accountant who counts every pawn island and refuses to take any uncalculated risks.

name: Andrej Horvat
bio: Offers exchanges at every turn and likes to steer the game into clear, simple positions.

name: Evelyn Mercer
bio: Retired programmer who plays logical, principled chess with few obvious weaknesses.

name: Santiago Reyes
bio: Brilliant attacking flair when inspired, though prone to impatient blunders in quiet positions.

name: Dorothy Carmichael
bio: Master of the London System who builds an unbreakable pyramid and waits for you to crack.

name: Lorenzo Conti
bio: Plays sharp Sicilian Dragon lines with zero regard for personal safety or endgame structure.

name: Joon-Ho Park
bio: Adaptable club player who smoothly transitions from solid openings into active middlegames.

name: Freja Holm
bio: Finds astonishingly creative defensive resources right after creating her own terrible problems.

name: Graham Holloway
bio: Methodical thinker who slowly suffocates your counterplay before winning a clean endgame.

name: Esme Navarro
bio: Swift, ruthless tactician who punishes even the slightest delay in castling with lethal force.

name: Idris Boateng
bio: Calculated strategist who balances long-term positional pressure with sharp tactical strikes.

name: Tomasz Zielinski
bio: Capable of deep 10-move calculations, yet occasionally bored into carelessness by dry positions.

name: Patricia O'Sullivan
bio: Disciplined positional player who punishes premature attacks with rock-solid defense.

name: Rafael Delgado
bio: Dazzling, flamboyant attacker who always chooses the sharpest, most dangerous variation.

name: Samuel Mensah-Bonsu
bio: Principled tournament regular with deep endgame technique and calm defensive resilience.

name: Viktoras Kazlauskas
bio: Genius-level tactical vision held back only by overconfidence and reckless pawn grabs.

name: Raymond Beauchamp
bio: Diplomatic strategist who accumulates small space advantages and never allows counterplay.

name: Haruka Sato
bio: Relentless attacking specialist who turns minor initiative into an unstoppable mating net.

name: Ananya Deshmukh
bio: Deeply prepared theorist who knows mainlines inside out and transitions smoothly to endgames.

name: Nikolai Volkov
bio: Escapes completely lost positions through outrageous swindles and chaotic tactical traps.

name: Willem Van Der Berg
bio: Cold, clinical positional grinder who dissects weak pawn structures with surgical precision.

name: Astrid Nystrom
bio: Fearless attacking powerhouse who dominates open files and crushes passive defenses.

name: Carlos Castellanos
bio: Complete candidate-master level engine persona with harmonious piece play across all phases.

name: Darius Varga
bio: Plays razor-sharp, provocative lines full of deep traps, occasionally outsmarting himself.

name: Reginald Pemberton
bio: Stubborn fortress builder capable of holding drawn endgames against relentless pressure.

name: Tamara Kovalenko
bio: Converts the slightest edge by trading into endgames she has studied for years.

name: Miriam Al-Jamil
bio: Analytical all-rounder combining deep calculation with classic positional understanding.

name: Ferenc Szabo
bio: Unpredictable veteran mixing eccentric opening choices with sudden grandmaster-level endgames.
